svg.text: soge — FX quote & execution service on AWS
TLS 1.3 end to end (API Gateway → ALB: TLS 1.3 or restricted 1.2, ADR-013) · 3 Availability Zones · no internet route from the VPC · KMS everywhere · GitHub Actions with OIDC, no stored credential
VPC · private subnets only · no IGW, no NAT
ECS: 3 → 6 tasks (auto scaling) · Aurora writer + reader in 2 AZ, failover ~30 s · cost-capped (max 2 ACU)
private access to ECR · CloudWatch Logs · Secrets Manager · S3
OIDC: short-lived token, then build · push · deploy
Icons: AWS Architecture Icons, release 01/30/2026. Solid arrows: user traffic · dashed: internal calls.
